recordedAtUtcSource: date -u, read from the shell at write time
whatThisRecordIs: an OPERATIONAL evidence-integrity rule for the CURRENT methodology generation. It states when a pre-socket address-policy refusal is evidence about the OPERATOR'S NETWORK VANTAGE rather than evidence about an institution, and what follows for the replacement ledger when it is
whatThisRecordIsNot: Methodology R4, or any revision of the frozen R3 bytes
a change to Q3 or to any replacement-reason precedence
a change to any SD7 or SD9 threshold
a change to any sampling, draw or reserve-order rule
a broadening of the address guard, or a licence to admit any address the guard refuses

methodologyR3.role: the frozen methodology this rule does NOT amend. Cited to fix exactly which generation the rule is operational for

ownerReserveOrderClarification.role: holds Q3, the replacement-reason precedence this rule leaves untouched. This rule decides WHETHER an obligation exists at all; Q3 decides which reason an obligation that DOES exist carries

recoveryDecision.role: the owner decision that ordered the targeted recovery instead of spending reserves on the Window-02 refusals

recoveryNetworkPrecondition.role: the six-condition structural proof that the recovery ran from a compliant vantage. Its condition list is the template this rule's clause 5 requires a revalidation to satisfy

recoveryLiveAuthority.role: the targeted three-run authority. It consumed no reserve and changed no organisation, slot, split, root authority or fetch policy - which is what made clause 5 satisfiable

recoveryLiveResult.role: the measured outcome: 43 fetch observations, every resolved address ordinary public IPv4, ZERO new address-policy refusals

recoveryAdjudication.role: the canonical state this rule is written against, and the record whose own nextOwnerDecision asked whether this rule should be written down

window02Adjudication.role: the record that HELD the slot-45 and slot-51 obligations rather than spending reserves on them. This rule is the generalisation of that hold, written down after the recovery proved it correct

capabilityReviewResolution.role: the earlier record that first placed address-policy refusals under Q3 rank 4. This rule does not reopen its Q3 mapping; it narrows the set of refusals that reach Q3 at all

replacementLedger.role: the artifact this rule protects from a spurious append. It is not modified by this record

theRule.statement: A pre-socket address-policy refusal that durable evidence shows was caused by the OPERATOR'S OWN network vantage - specifically an IPv6-only DNS64/NAT64 path whose resolver returns only translation-prefix representations of the target - is evidence about the measuring environment, not about the institution. It does not create a replacement obligation, does not consume a reserve, and does not displace the slot's current occupant. The slot is HELD and a targeted compliant-vantage revalidation is required before any institution-level adjudication of that slot.
theRule.whatItDecides: WHETHER a refusal reaches Q3 at all
theRule.whatItDoesNotDecide: which reason an obligation carries once one exists - that remains Q3, unchanged

appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.requirement: the acquisition run was blocked PRE-SOCKET by the landed address classifier
appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.howItIsProved: an orgunit_fetch_observations row with error_kind BLOCKED_BY_POLICY whose refusal precedes any connection, produced by the unmodified classifyIpAddress in src/orgunits/web/address.ts

appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.requirement: the target addresses OBSERVED BY THE GATEWAY were NAT64/DNS64 translation-prefix representations rather than ordinary reachable public target addresses
appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.howItIsProved: the recorded resolved addresses for the refused host are translation-prefix addresses (for example 64:ff9b::/96) or CLAT/protocol-assignment addresses standing in for an IPv4 destination, and NOT ordinary public addresses the institution actually publishes
notSatisfiedBy: a private or loopback address genuinely published by the institution
a public address the guard refuses for an unrelated reason
an address set containing at least one ordinary public address that was itself reachable

appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.requirement: the machine's active operator network was itself an IPv6-only DNS64/NAT64 vantage at the time of the run
appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.howItIsProved: contemporaneous structural evidence of the vantage: a DNS64 detector (ipv4only.arpa answering with synthesised AAAA records in the translation prefix), an IPv6-only default route, an active CLAT address, a cellular PDP or constrained interface - recorded independently of any institution
notSatisfiedBy: an inference from the refusal itself
a recollection that the network 'was probably' cellular

appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.requirement: NO institution-level HTTP/TLS/robots evidence was obtained for that target
appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.howItIsProved: the run produced no readable robots policy, no HTTP status and no page evidence for the host in question - there is genuinely nothing about the institution to adjudicate
notSatisfiedBy: a run that read robots.txt successfully and was then disallowed
a run that obtained any HTTP status from the institution
a run that yielded page evidence below the success threshold - that is a MIN_PAGES question, not a vantage question

appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.requirement: a compliant-vantage revalidation is MECHANICALLY POSSIBLE without changing organisation, slot, split, root authority or fetch policy
appliesOnlyWhenAllFiveAreProvedByDurable.howItIsProved: the same occupant can be re-measured by the landed code from a compliant vantage, with no reserve consumed and no artifact rewritten - as the targeted recovery series demonstrated
notSatisfiedBy: a revalidation that would require a policy change, a code change or a migration
a revalidation that would require assigning a different occupant

theRule.anySingleClauseUnprovedMeans: the rule DOES NOT APPLY and ordinary frozen Q3 governs the refusal exactly as before
consequencesWhenItApplies: PRESERVE the original run immutably as ENVIRONMENT evidence - it is never deleted, never rewritten and never reclassified as an institution failure
DO NOT create a replacement obligation from that run
HOLD the slot's current occupant - no reserve is assigned and the replacement ledger does not grow
REQUIRE a targeted compliant-vantage revalidation before any institution-level adjudication of that slot
record the hold explicitly, so that a later reader can see the obligation was withheld deliberately rather than overlooked

empiricalValidation.byWhat: the landed targeted vantage recovery series (authority 6eb14d418d0aa720b1fc3c0749fa48402c217621, result 5d4f4becf5c5dd5d1d06994e3af531d211c5fa94, adjudication cdda77d0653db460898d806bfe0667d5aeb7c09c)
whatItShowed: slot 51, whose Window-02 evidence was a pre-socket address refusal, went from 0 pages to 24 pages from a compliant vantage and is now ACQUISITION_SUCCESSFUL - had a reserve been spent on it, an occupant that in fact yields 24 pages would have been discarded

slot 45, whose Window-02 evidence was also a pre-socket address refusal, was REACHED from a compliant vantage and its robots.txt genuinely READ (HTTP 200, 151 bytes); the site's own policy then disallowed the root, which is a DIFFERENT and better-evidenced finding carrying Q3 rank 2 rather than the rank-4 fallback the NAT64 run produced
not one address-policy refusal occurred anywhere in the 43 fetch observations of the recovery series, and the database's six BLOCKED_BY_POLICY rows are still exactly the two Window-02 clusters
empiricalValidation.thisIsWhyTheRuleIsWrittenDownRatherThanA: the hold was a judgement call when Window 02 made it. The recovery turned it into a measured fact: the refusals carried no information about either institution, and one of the two occupants was in fact good

explicitNonGeneralisations: do NOT generalise this rule to arbitrary BLOCKED_BY_POLICY. Most address-policy refusals are genuine and belong to the institution's own published addresses

do NOT treat genuinely non-public institution addresses as operator-vantage failures. An institution that publishes a private or unroutable address has been correctly refused, and that IS institution-level evidence
do NOT weaken, bypass or special-case the address guard. The rule changes how a refusal is INTERPRETED afterwards; the guard's behaviour at the moment of refusal is unchanged and must stay unchanged
do NOT use this rule to retry a target from the same unsuitable vantage. The remedy is a compliant vantage, not a repeated attempt
do NOT use this rule to hold a slot indefinitely. It requires a revalidation, and a slot held without one is an open obligation on the operator, not a resolved slot

relationshipToQ3.howTheyCompose: this rule is a GATE in front of Q3, not a member of it. When the rule applies, no obligation is created and Q3 is never consulted. When the rule does not apply, Q3 governs unchanged, including the rank-4 treatment of an ordinary address-policy refusal
relationshipToQ3.whyThisIsNotAQ3Amendment: Q3 is a precedence ordering over replacement REASONS. It presupposes that a replacement is owed. The question this rule answers - whether the evidence was about the institution at all - is upstream of that ordering and cannot be expressed as a reordering of it

whyThisIsOperationalRatherThanMethodolog: it changes no SD7 or SD9 threshold
it changes no sampling, frame, draw or reserve-order rule
it changes no fetch policy and no timeout
it changes no success threshold and no pause condition
it controls only whether evidence was generated from a VALID acquisition vantage - a property of the measuring environment, not of the measurement design

operationalObligationItCreates.requirement: before every ordinary live acquisition window under the current authority, prove the active vantage is not the identified unsuitable DNS64/NAT64-only condition, using public-safe non-institution canaries and the gateway's own resolution and classification path
operationalObligationItCreates.ifTheVantageIsUnsuitable: STOP before live execution. Consume no reserve and create no institution failure from that environment
operationalObligationItCreates.whyTheObligationIsPreventiveRatherThanCo: the cheapest moment to avoid contaminated evidence is before the first request. This rule exists because the corrective path - a targeted recovery series - cost three extra live runs and a full adjudication cycle to undo two refusals

holdoutNonDisclosure.note: slot indices and splits are structural corpus coordinates and are recorded throughout this generation's governance. No institution identity appears here

immutability: append-only. This record is never edited. A later correction is a NEW record that supersedes it by name and says so.
